name: Fatui Skirmisher - Hydrogunner Legionnaire
original:
The Fatui Skirmisher - Hydrogunner Legionnaire checks the water tank of their gun at a Fatui field camp near Mondstadt's Wolvendom.

The Fatui Skirmisher - Hydrogunner Legionnaire looks up at the sound of your footsteps.

"Halt. This area is under Fatui supervision."

The Fatui Skirmisher - Hydrogunner Legionnaire waits, weapon ready.

Footsteps crunch nearby, and the Fatui Skirmisher - Hydrogunner Legionnaire steps out from cover.

"State your business, and keep your hands where I can see them."

The Fatui Skirmisher - Hydrogunner Legionnaire watches your every move.

The Fatui Skirmisher - Hydrogunner Legionnaire is resting at a Fatui field camp near Mondstadt's Wolvendom, but rises the moment you come into view.

"Not another step until I know who sent you."

notes: No Story Voice-Overs exist for this enemy; the limited combat voice lines were used as a tentative tone reference. Narration unchanged.
